text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everything that is about to happen is not 
a dream. So, let's keep our eyes wide 
open.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make intense, unforgettable memories 
for me... and for everyone! Let's make 
every single moment—shine.

"...Her words trailed off there. But—that 
was enough. That was more than enough to 
convey her feelings."

That day it was decided she would run in 
the Twinkle Series. With sparkling eyes, 
she was bursting with excitement for the 
future...

As she heads toward the greatest 
conclusion right now— Fine Motion is more 
beautiful than in any of my memories.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Spare me. I can't bear having to listen to 
them drone on about 'what an auspicious 
day it is.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There is only one thing I wish to ask, 
Fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Do you have the resolve to stand against 
this "Empress" upon an honorable stage?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Lady Air Groove. "On this 
auspicious day," in this magnificent race—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I have looked forward with all my heart 
to running an honorable race with you."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That works. Do you require an 
escort?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need it. —Because with these 
legs, I'm going to pass you!"
